title: Live imaging and quantitation of nascent transcription in Drosophila embryos
author: Hoppe, Ashe
materials: Leica TCS SP8 AOBS inverted microscope

steps.title: Apply memory‑adjusted HMM
steps.instruction: Use a memory‑adjusted Hidden Markov Model on the time‑lapse imaging data to infer the promoter state (ON or OFF) for each frame and to calculate transcriptional burst kinetics, including the transition rates kon and koff, assuming a two‑state promoter model.

steps.title: Quantify and compare transcription
steps.instruction: With the extracted transcription parameters, quantify the transcriptional response to signaling levels and compare these parameters between different genotypes or spatial positions within the embryo.
